proposed_facts.reason: The indexed, nullable stage-object factory calls the distinct two-argument setup helper. The new behavioral name resolves the rendered collision without claiming original spelling.
The initializer configures three records whose callback and updater implement contact-sensitive platforms, distinct from camera-driven vanish geometry.
Canonical stores clear exactly x8, x4 and x0. Contact transitions, animation-rate calls, both warning routes and per-update contact clearing match the explanation.

The code uses the unwrapped angle's sign and absolute-angle remainder, not a nearest-level search. Mode-1 contact changes mode without recomputing the increment; integration and accumulator clearing follow the switch.
The seventeen-element table initializes entries consumed by the falling-block controller, not the separately allocated vanish array.
State 1 preserves its timer when entering state 2. Quantized sampling, threshold checks, restoration, blinking and transition-frame increments match the canonical branches.
Every callback invocation is attachment-null-guarded; the callback itself is unchecked. Recursion follows JObj children and siblings, not DObj next chains, and forwards the u32 unchanged.
The initializer allocates the vanish subsystem consumed by the camera-gated updater. Its proposed name distinguishes it from the three contact platforms.

The independently inspected camera predicate returns true for CAM_BOUNDS_INSIDE. True activates collision in state 0; false starts retirement in state 2. Shared-joint retirement and fixed-entry exclusions are preserved.

The descriptor table contains twelve fixed and eight dynamic entries. Initialization, representation selection, four-state transitions and the shared-collision scan support the correction that state 2 is not absent.
The summary preserves distinct controllers, carried falling timers, fixed vanish exceptions and shared collision lifetime. The object-1 initialization gate encloses only the three obstacle updates.

contradictions.reason: Accepted deferrals for all eleven compiled-section facts and the .rodata link: declarations, literals and a four-case source switch establish source behavior, not emitted placement, section extent, alignment or dispatch-table representation.
The factory/setup-helper conflation is resolved by proposal 0. The factory selects a callback row and obtains an object before invoking the distinct setup helper.

The colliding platform initializer name and unsupported extra cleared field are resolved by proposals 1–2. Three contact-platform records have exactly three explicit zero stores and two distinct warning routes.
The nearest-level and immediate mode-recomputation claims are corrected by proposal 3. Entry into numeric mode 1 remains explicitly deferred because the inspected local initializer selects mode 0.
The falling initializer's vanish name and fresh-shake-duration interpretation are resolved by proposals 4–5. Seventeen falling entries use a timer carried across the state-1/state-2 boundary.
The nullable-DObj callback requirement is corrected by proposal 6: all attachment calls are guarded, while the callback pointer is not checked.

Proposals 7–10 resolve the vanish initializer collision, reversed camera polarity, absent-state interpretation and all-twenty-cycle implication. Twelve entries are fixed in state 2; eight cycle, and shared collision remains until all matching entries are state 0.
